title: Tape copying, editing: Greenfield Morning I Pushed An Empty Baby Carriage All Over The City by Yoko Ono | 1970
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Andy Stephens

An editing session for Yoko Ono’s debut solo album, Yoko Ono/Plastic Ono Band, took place on 4 November 1970.

It began with a new copy made of the 28 October mix of ‘Greenfield Morning I Pushed An Empty Baby Carriage All Over The City’. The edit piece ‘Bird FX’, made from the EMI effects library on 30 October, was then added. The result was mixed in stereo the following day.
